method: Independent ket-action derivation from the primary rendering and Eqs. (39)-(41); no file or cached value from input A was used while deriving these actions.
basis_action_convention: Each pair [a,b] denotes a|0>+b|1>; the two listed pairs are the images of |0> and |1> respectively.
convention_map_to_a: Input-A matrices have action columns; input B lists those same columns as ket images. Input-A row mixing U acts on (T1,T2,T3)^T. The Bell/Choi convention is input tensor output, with column-major vec(K)=(K00,K10,K01,K11).
